notes: New: the Pixel Pass. A 100-tier season shared by all three games, with cash every tier and unlocks every 5 (clothes, car paints, ball skins, titles). Also new: 70 achievements, a daily login streak, weekly challenges, a first-win-of-the-day double-XP bonus, and daily challenges for boxing, hoops AND racing. Late levels take longer now, and you can rebirth up to 10 times. Animations: heads snap and bodies fold on hits, cars bounce on their springs, show opposite lock and pop flames from the exhaust, rims bend on dunks and the ball squashes when it bounces.
